title: You can be chosen… and still fall if you stop guarding your heart.
paragraphs:
You can be chosen… and still fall
if you stop guarding your heart.
“Therefore let anyone who thinks that he stands take heed lest he fall.” — 1 Corinthians 10:12

Saul was chosen.
Samson was chosen.
Judas walked close enough to hear the voice of Jesus.

Not because God failed.
Because pride crept in.
Because compromise stayed unchallenged.
Because what should have been guarded… was neglected.

Being used by God is not the same as staying surrendered to God.
Calling is not a substitute for consecration.
Anointing is not armor for a careless heart.

That’s why Paul warns us.
Take heed.
Stay low.
Stay watchful.
Stay near the cross.
The heart that stops trembling before God starts drifting from Him.

If you’ve grown careless, come back.
If you’ve been coasting, repent.
If you’ve fallen, Christ still receives the broken who return to Him.
Jesus does not just expose pride—He restores the humble.

Guard your heart.
Not in fear.
In faith.

Because the same grace that chose you…
is the grace that will keep you when you cling to Christ.
